wayland-sessions/aqueous.desktop.metadata:
[Desktop Entry]
Name=Aqueous
Comment=Aqueous Wayland window manager
# Launched under uwsm (Universal Wayland Session Manager): uwsm wraps aqueous-wm
# as a proper systemd user unit, exports/cleans the Wayland environment, activates
# graphical-session.target, and tears the whole session down cleanly on exit. The
# compositor itself still finalizes the live env via `uwsm finalize` from
# /usr/bin/aqueous-init. Falls back to running aqueous-wm directly if uwsm is
# unavailable (see aqueous-init's non-uwsm branch).
Exec=uwsm start -- aqueous-wm
TryExec=uwsm
Type=Application
DesktopNames=Aqueous
Keywords=wm;wayland;aqueous;
